levels.label: Breaking
levels.description: Existing conforming consumers may fail or become invalid.

levels.label: Potentially breaking
levels.description: May break strict consumers; manual compatibility review is required.

levels.label: Deprecation
levels.description: Still available but should not be used for new implementations.

levels.label: Review required
levels.description: Automated structural analysis cannot safely decide semantic compatibility.

levels.label: Non-breaking
levels.description: Backward-compatible additive or relaxed change under the current standard.

levels.label: Documentation
levels.description: Descriptive documentation changed without detected machine semantics.
